items.title: Cursor agents gain Computer Use to control local desktop apps
facts: Cursor can now control your computer. Agents can drive desktop apps like the iOS Simulator to test the features they build.
Computer Use lets agents click and type across any app on your computer, not just the browser.
Cursor uses it on its own when a task needs it. You can also ask for it by @-mentioning Computer Use in your prompt.
Update Cursor to try it.

items.title: Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro open-weight MoE with strong coding performance
facts: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro: our most capable 3T-class open-weight model. 1M-token context, 2.8T total / 104B active params (MoE), Multimodal.
On Terminal-Bench 4.0, K3.1 Pro scores 65.7%, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2%) and narrowly behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%).
Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed (2–3× faster) are now live on Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and the Kimi API. Full weights by Nov 4, 2026.
API pricing listed at $2 input / $10 output per million tokens for kimi-k3.1-pro.

items.title: Artificial Analysis launches Coding Agent Index v2.0
facts: Announcing Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index v2.0: FrontierCode v1.1 from Cognition replaces DeepSWE, SWE-Atlas-QnA grading is revised, and Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code leads at 61.7.
The Index evaluates models together with their agent harnesses, now across 290 tasks covering software engineering, terminal use, and repository Q&A, with the three benchmarks weighted equally.
Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 (max) scores 61.7, followed by Claude Code with Claude Sonnet 5.5 (max) at 59.3.
Across 21 configurations measured on both versions, mean Index score moves from 54.8 to 47.4.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.310 released with Monitor tool and reliability fixes
facts: Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too.
Fixed requests failing behind some gateways and compatible servers that reject the effort-2025-11-24 beta value or mid-conversation system messages; Claude Code now retries without them.
Fixed compaction after a "Prompt is too long" error keeping too much of a conversation with dense text, such as base64 or SVG, so the next request could fail again.
Improved auto mode's prompt before the first read outside the working directories.

items.title: GitHub Copilot usage metrics API adds client-level data for tools like OpenCode
facts: The Copilot usage metrics API now reports model usage from more of the tools your developers use with Copilot, including tools like OpenCode that weren’t previously captured in your reports.
A new totals_by_client array is available in the enterprise, organization, enterprise-user, and organization-user 1-day and 28-day reports.
Each totals_by_client entry includes client, request_count, session_count, token_usage, and totals_by_model.

items.title: GitHub Copilot in Teams turns notifications into code
facts: The new GitHub app in Microsoft Teams brings GitHub notifications and GitHub Copilot together, helping your team turn repository updates into action.
When an update needs action, reply to the notification and @mention GitHub with the task you want GitHub Copilot to carry out.

GitHub Copilot uses the issue or pull request linked in the notification and the conversation in the thread to understand the task. It can reproduce a bug, run tests, implement a fix, and prepare a pull request for review.
